text: Cynar is not an independent company - it is a brand in the portfolio of Davide Campari-Milano N.V., the Milan-headquartered spirits group listed on Borsa Italiana, sitting in its 'House of Aperitifs' brand cluster. Campari itself is controlled by the Garavoglia family through their holding company but has no state shareholder. Human-rights relevance is alcohol-sector labour and agricultural sourcing (sugar, agave, botanicals).
